name: Source chips
definition: Clickable chips that open source notes (data definitions, references, glossary).
bestUse: Talks whose claims will be checked.

demo.how: Numbered chips sit right after the words they support. Select a chip (click, or Tab then Enter) to open its note: a data definition, a reference or a glossary entry. Escape or the same chip closes it, so the slide stays clean until someone asks. Content is illustrative.
